newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Volgotanker shows preliminary 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Russia Volgotanker shows preliminary 1996 loss.

text.p: Shipping company AO Volgotanker VLGT.RTS, a major carrier of Russian oil, reported a preliminary 1996 loss by Russian accrual accounting standards, chief accountant Vladimir Shtanichev said on Tuesday.
Shtanichev told Reuters that a fall in the water level in the Volga, the main channel used by Volgotanker, was the reason for the loss because it had almost halved cargo levels.
"We failed to cope with the volume of shipping we had planned for 1996," Shtanichev said.

Volgotanker will not pay dividends for 1996. In 1995 the company paid 250 percent on common shares with a face value of 100 roubles. The shares were quoted at $4.15 on Russia's RTS trading system on Monday (rpt Monday).
Volgotanker does not have preferred shares.
Tamara Gorbatova from Volgotanker's securities department, said the company had dropped the idea of a new share issue.
The company's shareholders' meeting will take place on April 11.
Volgotanker's authorised capital is 1.06 billion roubles.
Its main shareholder is the government with 20 percent of shares. Burlington Investment Ltd owns almost 20 percent.
